verdict.rationale: Aider has no first-party way to launch or manage fleets of parallel, long-running autonomous agents. It offers scriptable building blocks: `--message` runs one instruction and exits, and the Python `Coder.run` API executes one instruction and returns. A user could orchestrate many such runs with external tooling. Community posts only describe hypothetically chaining scripted runs, plus a third-party 'navigator-mode' autonomy add-on that is not part of Aider itself. Missing for 10: native multi-agent/parallel orchestration, long-running (hours/days) autonomous sessions, task assignment and monitoring across agents, and first-party docs or hands-on corroboration of fleet usage.
